_note: 學習路徑內容第19批 #1／6：關係代名詞 that（eng.t_mid.relcl.that，會考級／中階）。that 在限定關係子句可指人也可指物；用於限定子句（無逗號），逗號後的非限定子句不可用 that（改用 who/which）；that 不能緊接在介系詞後面（介系詞移到句尾）；當 that 是子句受詞時可省略。誘答鎖『逗號後用 that／介系詞後 that／what 接名詞後／受詞重複加 it』等唯一正解；不把方言或口語也成立者講成絕對錯。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rth_）。

units.title_zh: 關係代名詞 that（指人或物、限定子句）
units.can_do: 我能用關係代名詞 that 把兩個句子接起來說明人或物，知道 that 用在限定子句（無逗號）、不能接在介系詞後面，當受詞時可省略。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In defining (restrictive) relative clauses, 'that' can refer to both people and things: 'the man that lives here', 'the car that broke down'.
claims.verification_ref: 限定關係子句中 that 可指人也可指物；the man that lives here／the car that broke down；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'that' is used in defining relative clauses, not after a comma in non-defining clauses (which use who/which): 'My bike, which is red, is new' (not 'My bike, that is red').
claims.verification_ref: that 只用於限定子句、不用於逗號後的非限定子句（非限定用 who/which）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'that' cannot come directly after a preposition; we say 'the music that she listened to' (preposition at the end) or 'to which she listened', not 'the music to that she listened'.
claims.verification_ref: that 不能緊接在介系詞後面；介系詞移到句尾（the house that I live in）或改用 in which；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When 'that' is the object of the relative clause, it can be left out: 'the film (that) we saw'; and the clause does not repeat the object with a pronoun like 'it'.
claims.verification_ref: that 當子句受詞時可省略（the film (that) we saw）；子句不再用 it 重複受詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'that' is a relative pronoun. In a defining relative clause it can point to a person or a thing. It comes after a noun and starts a clause that tells us more about that noun. The girl that sits next to me is kind.
teach.zh_hint: that 是關係代名詞，在『限定』關係子句裡可以指人也可以指物。它放在名詞後面，帶出一句說明這個名詞的話：The girl that sits next to me is kind.（坐我旁邊的那個女生人很好。）

teach.body: The girl that sits next to me is kind.
teach.zh_hint: 坐我旁邊的女生人很好。that 指人、限定是哪一個女生。

teach.body: Use 'that' in a defining clause (no commas; it pins down which one). For the extra note after a comma, do not use that; use who (people) or which (things). I like the song that you wrote.
teach.zh_hint: that 用在『限定子句』（沒有逗號，幫你鎖定是哪一個）。逗號後面的補充說明不用 that，要用 who（人）或 which（物）：I like the song that you wrote.（我喜歡你寫的那首歌。）

teach.body: I like the song that you wrote.
teach.zh_hint: 我喜歡你寫的那首歌。that 指物、你寫的那一首。

teach.body: When 'that' is the object of the clause, you can leave it out: The book (that) I bought is great. Also, 'that' cannot come right after a preposition -- move the preposition to the end (the house that I live in), not 'the house in that I live'.
teach.zh_hint: 當 that 是子句裡的受詞時可以省略：The book (that) I bought is great.（我買的那本書很棒。）另外，that 不能緊接在介系詞後面——要把介系詞放到句尾（the house that I live in），不說 the house in that I live。

teach.body: The book that I bought is very interesting.
teach.zh_hint: 我買的那本書很有趣。that 當受詞、也可省略成 The book I bought…。

practice.stem: 選正確：He is the only person ____ can help us.（他是唯一能幫我們的人）

distractor_rationales.which: which 指物，這裡 person 是人。
distractor_rationales.what: what 本身含『the thing that』，不接在名詞 person 後面當關係代名詞。
distractor_rationales.whose: whose 表所有（某人的…），這裡不是所有關係。

practice.feedback: the only person that can help us：that 指人、限定子句（the only 後面特別常用 that）。

practice.stem: 選正確：This is the bike ____ broke down yesterday.（這就是昨天壞掉的那台腳踏車）

distractor_rationales.who: who 指人，這裡 bike 是物。
distractor_rationales.whom: whom 是指人的受格，也不用於物。
distractor_rationales.what: what 不接在名詞 bike 後面當關係代名詞。

practice.feedback: the bike that broke down：that 指物、限定是哪一台。

practice.stem: 選正確：My father, ____ is a doctor, works at night.（我爸是醫生，他晚上工作）

distractor_rationales.that: 逗號後面的非限定子句不能用 that，指人要用 who。
distractor_rationales.which: which 指物，這裡 father 是人。
distractor_rationales.what: what 不接在名詞 father 後面當關係代名詞。

practice.feedback: 逗號後的補充說明用 who（人）／which（物），不用 that。

practice.answer: The movie that we watched was funny.
options: The movie that we watched was funny.
The movie what we watched was funny.
The movie that we watched it was funny.
The movie which we watched it was funny.

名詞 movie 後面不用 what 當關係代名詞。
子句裡已用 that 當受詞，不能再加 it 重複受詞。
一樣多了 it，子句受詞重複了。

practice.feedback: The movie that we watched…：that 當受詞（也可省略成 The movie we watched…），不再加 it。

practice.answer: This is the house that I grew up in.
options: This is the house that I grew up in.
This is the house in that I grew up.
This is the house what I grew up in.
This is the house who I grew up in.

that 不能緊接在介系詞 in 後面；要把 in 放句尾，或改用 in which。
名詞 house 後面不用 what 當關係代名詞。
who 指人，這裡 house 是物。

practice.feedback: the house that I grew up in：介系詞 in 放句尾，that 不接在介系詞後面。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The book that I bought is very interesting.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：that、bought（過去式）、interesting 有沒有拼對、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。關係子句一氣呵成、句尾下收。

lines.text: She is the friend that helps me most.
lines.intonation: friend 稍停、句尾 most 下收

lines.text: This is the song that I love.
lines.intonation: 平穩、句尾 love 下收
